style: gentle bedtime lullaby for toddlers, soft warm female vocal, slow and calm, music box, soft piano, harp, light strings, dreamy, sleepy, clear gentle diction, vocals start immediately on the very first beat with the chorus, no instrumental intro, short outro
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Waves are rolling, soft and slow,
Back and forth they come and go,
Hush now, hush now, close your eyes,
Sleep beneath the starry skies.

[Verse 1]
The ocean whispers, shh, shh, shh,
Little boats are resting, hush,
Seashells sleeping in the sand,
Moonlight shining on the land.

[Chorus]
Waves are rolling, soft and slow,
Back and forth they come and go,
Hush now, hush now, close your eyes,
Sleep beneath the starry skies.

[Verse 2]
Little fishes, swimming deep,
Snuggle down and fall asleep,
Gentle turtles, slow and calm,
Rocking in the ocean's arms.

[Bridge]
Breathe in slowly, like a wave comes in,
Breathe out softly, let the rest begin,
Rock, rock, rocking, side to side,
Floating on the sleepy tide.

[Verse 3]
Bunny, Lamb and Teddy too,
The ocean sings a song for you,
Waves are quiet, stars are bright,
Goodnight ocean, sleep tight.

[Chorus]
Waves are rolling, soft and slow,
Back and forth they come and go,
Hush now, hush now, close your eyes,
Sleep beneath the starry skies.

[Outro]
Shh, shh, shh. Goodnight.

meta.title: Sleepy Ocean Waves 🌙 Calm Lullaby for Babies | Moonbeam
meta.description:
A calm ocean lullaby. Soft waves roll in and out, little boats rest, seashells sleep in the sand and turtles rock gently as Luna, Bunny, Lamb and Teddy drift off.
A slow breathing break, in like a wave and out like the tide, helps little ones fall asleep. For babies and toddlers.
